?

Jeremiah 31:25 MSG
I’ll refresh tired bodies; I’ll restore tired souls.
?
The first part of the statement above☝ connotes assurance, yes an assurance not from man, but from God. Same thing can be said of the second part too.

✔What a reassurance.

There is no level or aspect of tiredness God cannot turn around.✔
?
Regardless of the source or nature of your tiredness, you can leverage on this and the nature of God to always do you Good.
?
Luke 22v43 TPT
Jesus called for an angel of glory to strengthen him, and the angel appeared.????

?When Jesus was physically, emotionally, psychologically and “spiritually” drained, He called for an Angel of glory to strengthen Him.

?When He called, the Bible records that the angel ??‍♂appeared.
?
✔You can do same today in any area you feel or know you are tired.

?You may be too tired to go on or even stand to your feet, an angel of glory dispatched from the throne room of God is already at your service.

✔As you call today:
You will be strengthened to pursue your dreams:
✔Strengthened for the journey ahead..
✔Strengthened to pick up the pieces and start all over again..
?Strengthened to rebuild & restart.

✔In whatever area you need strength to make your life better, you will have it today in Jesus name
